speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to help me understand your condition, please tell me how many hours of life you have experienced and what specific breathing difficulties you are observing?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. Given your prematurity at 33 weeks and onset of distress just 2 hours after birth, we must rule out Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas for pH and PaO2. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_XRay.

speaker: Doctor

The pulse oximetry shows normal readings, which helps us assess the current oxygenation status despite the initial gas exchange abnormalities.
